reconfigure.title: Vehicle and blocks
reconfigure.description: Quick guide: 1) Forward direction: pick the board axis that points to the front, or 'From drive calibration'. 2) Park on truly level ground and press 'Save as level' (can be repeated anytime, only changes the level reference). 3) Drive calibration (only needed for 'From drive calibration'): press start, wait 2 s, accelerate straight 1 to 3 times and brake to a full stop, then press stop. The switch 'Active' is not needed for calibrating. Full guide: link 'Visit' on the device page.

user.title: Relays & inputs
user.description: On the VAN PI CORE the MCP23017 sits at 0x20 on I2C bus 1: GPA0-7 = inputs 1-8, GPB0-7 = relays 1-8.

data_description.invert_inputs: On means input pulled to ground (default for the VAN PI CORE).
data_description.keep_state: On: relays keep their state when Home Assistant restarts. Off: all relays are switched off on start.

names.title: Names
names.description: Names for relays and inputs. Names from the old mcp23017 component are pre-filled. Empty = 'Relais n' / 'Eingang n'.

error.not_found: No MCP23017 answers at this address.
error.already_configured: This address is already set up.

user.title: Tank
user.description: Tank input 1-4 of the VAN PI CORE. The sensor type (voltage or resistive) is set per channel pair 1+2 and 3+4 in the "Tank inputs" entry.

data_description.curve: Points as "voltage in volts : level", separated by commas. Example 100 L tank: 0:0, 0.49:50, 1.6:100 means 0 V = 0 L, 0.49 V = 50 L, 1.6 V = 100 L. Values in between are interpolated linearly; below the first and above the last point that point's level applies. The tank's "Voltage" sensor shows the current voltage.
data_description.divider_ratio: 1 if the sensor is connected directly.

user.description: VAN PI CORE: UART4 (/dev/ttyAMA4) = MPPT, UART5 (/dev/ttyAMA5) = SmartShunt. Important: remove the old YAML entry for the same port first, two readers on one port disturb each other.
